visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails and a beige t-shirt with a crocodile graphic stands on a long brown golf putting mat in a bright living room. An adult male in striped shorts stands behind her. To the right is a white storage unit with several drawers. (2) The girl walks to the storage unit and opens a white drawer, revealing several golf balls. She reaches in with her small hands to pick them up. The room is brightly lit with natural-feeling indoor light. (3) The girl returns to the mat, bends down, and carefully places a white golf ball on a designated white dot. She holds a light blue toy golf putter. The mat has distance markings and brand graphics. (4) An older girl in a white t-shirt enters the frame and takes a turn with the blue putter. The younger girl watches from the side. The background shows a wooden floor and an air purifier. (5) The adult male bends down behind the younger girl, placing his hands over hers on the putter to guide her swing. They are both looking down at the white golf ball on the mat. (6) After playing, the younger girl returns to the white cabinet and places the golf balls back into the drawer. She then walks toward the camera, smiling and waving as she prepares to go to bed. (7) The video ends with a pink screen featuring a small cartoon illustration and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, rhythmic acoustic guitar and piano BGM in a major key. A woman's voice is heard laughing and speaking enthusiastically. A child's voice responds with excited babbles. (2) A mechanical click is heard as a drawer opens, followed by the soft thud of plastic golf balls being moved. The father's voice enters, speaking in a gentle, supportive tone. (3) A sharp, bright 'ding' sound effect punctuates a successful action. The child's speech exhibits a high pitch and rising intonation. The BGM remains consistent and light. (4) Multiple voices overlap as the older sister joins. Laughter from the adults creates a warm atmosphere. The sound of footsteps on the wooden floor is subtly audible beneath the music. (5) The father's voice counts 'one, two, three' clearly, followed by a 'hey' exclamation as the ball is hit. The sound of the plastic putter striking the ball is a dry, percussive click. (6) As the activity winds down, the vocal intensity decreases. The child says 'goodnight' in a soft, sleepy but sweet tone. The BGM fades out as the final cartoon-style sound effect plays over the logo.
